summary: Curated the first-print command surface around source-backed Federal Register and Regulations.gov recipes instead of exposing raw endpoint mirrors.
reason: Policy monitoring workflows need stable agent-ready outputs with explicit source caveats, not raw endpoint mirroring that pushes upstream filter details into every caller.
validated_outcome: Live validation covered Federal Register search/rules plus Regulations.gov docket and comments reads; deadline polling is documented for a configured api.data.gov key because DEMO_KEY can rate-limit.
